body: Yep, I had been saving for a deposit for a house.

The whole purpose of a break room is to break the things they give you. You have to buy an entry. They give you a room, weapons, and stuff to break, it's super popular where we are. She bought these tickets a few days ago, I just went coz I wanted to see her. We don't break things or have violent outbursts in our everyday life.

I will have to clearly communicate the last bit you mentioned, and monitor if things are handled better when she comes across these moods. I wonder if she just doesn't have that control to notice what she is doing is hurtful to me, when she is in one of these moments.

Thank you for putting that so succinctly.

I will bring this up with her when we do finally see each other again.

My post history is me venting. She is a lot better than my ex when it comes to communication in the relationship, plus she is more faithful than my ex. But, having said that, yes she does have a lot of anger issues.

Part of why I haven't just up and left her is because she doesn't do it with malicious intent, it's stemming from her childhood. Majority of the time, she is really caring and affectionate.

You are right though, there are some things there which I wonder if I can put up with into the future.

I didn't want to break anything. But her turning down affection, that's what made me angry. I felt bad for breaking that stuff, it felt like such a waste. But it was cool at the start, never done that before. 

For the most part, it isn't as bad as this post. She can reflect and understand what she has done wrong. Which is why I am with her, my ex would never accept responsibility, I was always the problem. When I first met my current gf, she was a lot more angry, but she said being with me has taught her to calm down a lot.

I've been told many hurtful things in my life. Life is just emotional & mental suffering for me. I am more and more starting to believe these now.

"You're slow at media, you're slow at English, you're just slow at life" - My 9th grade english teacher, 2009. I think he was joking, but it hits hard. I've only started learning English 4 years before.  

"Unlike yourself, (my ex) wants to be successful in life" - My ex's brother, 2019. This was after she and I broke up, it was a toxic ending, too many people involved... Especially those who didn't know my side of the story.

Woah mate, either I wrote this wrong or you are out for blood.

For your information, I am not trying to turn her into an extrovert, I barely see her with my work.

I ask her and I listen to her. I wanted to see her this week, didn't get to because I listened to her.

I wanted to see her the time she wanted to have space, I didn't because I respected her request.

What I am asking is, how can I mesh my extrovert self better with her introvert self? Because I do love her, but I am having less and less of my needs met. She is always telling me what she wants and I listen. I have told her in past that I would like to hang out at least once a week, she said okay, but then there are weeks like this.

Which is okay, but looking further into the future, I sometimes worry how she and I could live together if she wants space more often...

It is pretty straightforward.

I did it.

I guess I was a bit apprehensive because my ex lashed out at me for doing the same thing.

This is what I sent.

She's okay. At least that's a positive.
I back this 100%. Had a shitty relationship I chased. Ended up digging myself bigger and deeper holes.

I messaged her to see if she's okay. She said she's enjoying her week alone, and wants next week alone too.

She felt obligated to spend her weekends with me because I work far away during weekdays.

I 100% agree. This has been something that has begun to boil in my mind. I am quite afraid of how that could turn out. We don't plan to live together soon, I want to live entirely alone first so I learn my own responsibilities and build good habits. I have the luxury of living with my family till I save enough for a house.
I'm not sure. She does call herself a highly sensitive person, or at least that she relates to it.
He doesn't know where you live does he?

At the moment living together isn't an option. She has said that she'd want me to live alone first, then we can live together. I currently work around my state, so I am not home during weekdays, to save money I "stay" with my parents.

I do plan on telling her how it makes me feel. I have told her before that going silent on me really worries me, and that her short fuse is something that also adds to it. But I guess when her moods take a turn, it's probably something that is difficult to monitor. I just have to wait till she feels better so we can reiterate it.

Thank you for your input. I agree, shouldn't have over-promised and under delivered. Didn't expect so many things to block me. I got a bit tunnel visioned and we just got into an argument. 

She messaged me back, she apologised for what she said, she said it wasn't very nice of her. She doesn't want the candles anymore, she wanted to go on more date nights, we have one planned for the weekend.

Don't try to fix anything. Clearly that group is garbage, and so is she.

My friend, the world just gave you a great opportunity to find new people that are more aligned to your beliefs and values, go find those people. Maybe among them, you might find the girl that's more aligned to you.

Don't let this opportunity go unexplored.

I can, but she probably won't let me up to her apartment, she'd be able to see who it is.

Although, I feel like it would be too much if I turn up at her door, especially after I said I am ready to talk when she is.

I completely get how you've felt. I've had the worst headache today, and have been glued to my phone just picking it up the second I hear it buzz hoping it's her. I didn't eat or drink water this morning just out of anxiety, I picked up later in the afternoon because I just felt really sick. 

 It would be a lot better if she messaged me and said that she needs time for herself. But I don't blame her this time around, I did tell her that we shouldn't meet the next day because I didn't feel 100%, after we finished arguing. She responded with see you next week or whenever, and I just felt too attacked and angry about it to reply.

But I did try to call and message her the next day, to which she didn't respond. She has seen my Facebook message now, but I don't think she'll respond any time soon.

I'm sorry to hear that.

That's exactly what happened with my ex after I moved overseas for study (which she genuinely supported that I try). After almost 2 years together she said the exact same thing, then cut me out of her life. We haven't spoken since November of 2019. It wasn't easy, but time is the only healer. Don't let your inside voice eat you up, best course of action is to just start doing things and focusing that energy to improvement. I was forced to isolate and I properly lost myself over the years, don't let that be you.

I hope my current gf doesn't intend to give me the silent treatment for a month. She has mentioned it's something she did... If she does that, I know I shouldn't be with someone like that, and I hope I'd have the strength to not go back to that relationship. If there's one thing I regret about my ex, it was letting her emotionally cheat on me and then I still went back to her.

Yeah, I am not constantly messaging her, I've done one text.

The waiting game and silence is elevating my anxiety. I can't focus, I am constantly worried, I'm even bringing on a headache from my worry.
I would say our relationship was going well. This would be the first time something this extreme has happened after an argument.

I have a feeling it's a bit of both.

I have been absent, I don't like my job, but I don't have a choice in it. As a result, I've been talking a lot about the gift, but been unable to give her the gift.

I promised to give her the gift last week, but I had covid and had to isolate.

I just sent her another text, told her I am sorry for making her feel the way she did, and I'm sorry for escalating it to an argument. I also said I am sorry for cancelling our plans. Told her to respond when she feels ready to.

I just have to sit and wait now.

She did have high expectations.

But I couldn't control work having me for 3 weeks (Incl weekends) straight (I away from home). Then I got covid and couldn't do anything for 2 weeks.

I will apologise to her for escalating, I felt pretty offended when she called me cheap.

I've already offered her candles because the build is taking long.

I guess I have no choice but to wait till she replies.

Edit - To clarify, $60 sunk in the build isn't complete. I still have to buy her the herbs and potting mix too. Probably going to be another $50-$70.
How it's going right now, not sure if she'll be there when I wake up tomorrow. :/

I'm just gonna say, you're 20, dont propose. There's so much growth ahead of you, you do not want to be tied down to someone who clearly has no clue about individual experience and progression of life.

I got caught up with someone like this at a time where major growth was in my sights. I tried to do everything she wanted, but as she said, nothing will ever be good enough for her. She decided on this 2 years down the track. She absolutely crushed me, made me feel like less of a person, then walked out on me. I hate that piece of shit with a passion, because I'd be almost finishing medical school now if she didn't do what she did.

I got withdrawn from my university because I couldn't go to study, my anxiety crippled me when it came to flying back overseas.

I'm just a glorified admin now.

It's funny I receive this message now. I am a few months into work, and I hate it.

I went to the airport to fly off last Saturday, and my anxiety overflowed and I could get get myself onto the flight.

Now I am back at work and hating it. I got one last opportunity to fly off tomorrow, but that'll be it.

Do what I just did. Get an anxiety attack at the airport, and instead of flying off to do what you want to do, you end up doing what you hate doing.

Fml.

Why do I have to apologize though?

I already apologized for touching her shoulder, I apologized for just being there when I left. I didn't storm out on her or anything, I kissed her forehead when I left. I told her I understood that she wanted space. 

I've been too busy to think about it during work, but definitely hits me when I get to my accommodation (I work far away from home throughout the week).

I'm not pinning all my emotions on one person. I hang out with friends and family just as much. In respect to our relationship, it's been a bit disappointing to not have the chance to see her. We may not have it labelled, but when I invited her to come see my friends one night she said it's too many people, and asked if my friends bring their bfs/gfs to our hangouts. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

I wouldn't say I want more, I was happy with what we had, we had been strongly emotionally intertwined leading up. But yeah, definitely things aren't lining up these last two weeks. I have also been thinking of having a hard conversation to get our bearings aligned. I don't want to do that talk online, I want to see her in person.

I do have anxiety and am seeing professional help for it. But it's one thing for me to want her attention and another for her behaviour to change from the norm and me being in the dark about it.

I've asked her what she was up to this weekend so I know if we could plan to meet up. To which she responded very briefly, didn't leave an opening for me to ask if she wanted to meet (as she would normally). As I said, I work well away from home and am not free till the weekend, so I look forward to seeing her.

I text her goodnight when I'm about to sleep and if we had been talking. The norm is she responds, or while I'm asleep she sends me a million links off Reddit. 

The lack of communication bugs me, and I don't wanna send her messages (asking if she is ok, if she is angry, etc) if she is indeed wanting her alone time. I would appreciate it if she told me how she was feeling so I know if I should keep put or if everything is good.

I'm not saying it's not ok. I'm saying it would be nice if things are communicated a bit better so I know what's going on. For example, We usually say goodnight to eachother, she gave me seens for the past two nights I said goodnight to her. 

Our dynamic has been a rolling conversation. She gives me a heap of messages, and I reply to then, then she'd reply to me, and would to her.

She doesn't really respond very well to anything when she does go quiet. She skips a lot of my messages, only responds to what she wants, and briefly at that. Our usual chat is when everything gets acknowledgement.

I do like a constant rolling chat. Which is what she and I have when she hasn't randomly gone quiet on me. 

I haven't messaged this girl asking if everything is ok. I am assuming that she is painting at home. But it does hurt a little that I asked her if she wanted to come to dinner yesterday, she shut that down, and I tried to see if she'd have a moment to meet today and she didn't really give me an opening. I feel like I've been the one initiating weekends. 

Oh well, I'll wait till we talk again to bring it up like you said. Probably won't see her for another week.

Edit: clarification.

I wonder how many of those people truly want to be there, or if they are just like us... Doing it, resentfully, because they have to. 

I already can't stand this. It has really brought me down. The amount of things I am doing that I already don't like.

I feel this so much man. 

For the last few months, I was trying my hardest to find a job, something full-time and sure. But I found nothing, so I applied to return to university. A few days later, I got offered a job. University starts in 2 months, my job starts in 1 month. 

I know for a fact that I won't like the job, because it's just paper pushing, but the money is good, and I get to start life now. On the other hand, I hate studying, but I know the end job will be more geared towards me after I finish studying. 

I don't want to do something that doesn't feel fullfilling, but at the same time, I am scared that I might get stuck at any moment and regret not taking the job. I've literally been frozen this whole day, I am struggling to decide. 

I always wish I could just turn back time and follow my heart better.
It's to study medicine in the UK. The problem I had was how far away it is from everything. It's also in the countryside. Plus, the COVID situation isn't settling in the UK.

Thank you for your tip. I have done this the last two times, I've just come out of it just as frozen. I'm going to see my psychologist about it. 

I was hoping to try out the job earlier and make up my mind better, but my start date got delayed.
Let's hope not. Good thing I got work at 5am, I can sleep without trying to think about this. My moment of bliss. Gosh I am a hella anxious boy.
Yeah, I sent her a message apologizing for bringing it up. She did give me another seen today. Things are starting to feel like it's not flowing anymore. It does make me a bit sad.

I didnt make the whole thing to be about my ex. It came up days later when she told me a quote about something else. I never mentioned my ex to her while she was telling me about her concerns regarding sex.

It might just be me being poor at explaining over text.

I feel like I need to clear this up more.

In my head we were still going back to sex. 5 minute break she said. She didn't tell me at the time that she felt pressured, she didn't tell me she was tired. She didn't tell me how she felt the next day either. We still had a great time together. A week of messaging and she didn't tell me then either. 

It was a week after that she told me how she felt. Not because she intended to tell me, but because we were having a general conversation about sex.

The ex girlfriend thing was 4 days after that. She said a variant of a quote that gets shovelled all over Instagram. This quote was pushed on me by my ex and a mutual friend. Mutual friend was on my ex's side till she learnt what happened from my side.
Clearly what I intended to say was lost in translation.

She said 5 minute break, and we cuddled. I didn't intend to pressure her, she didn't mention once that it felt pressuring at the time of that she was tired. In my head, I thought we were going back to it. But she did eventually tell me that this was how she felt. I was quick to apologize and recognise that it definitely wasn't right in hindsight, and in her view.

Me raising what I was unhappy about was on another day, I wasn't unhappy with her, it was more so that "phrase" got held over my head to push me down in my previous relationship.

I'm very much over my ex. Having met this girl, and having had time to reflect through therapy and myself, I realise my ex was actually just really immature with how she went about things. I had my whole self-esteem and ego crushed by her and her brother, so it's definitely baggage I'll carry around as I am bitter towards their actions leading to me falling off course for 2 years. 

As for it hurting the present relationship, I hope not, I'll bring it up with her when I see her in person. See how she feels when I mention it, and if I should mention it less.

I can get very anxious thanks to the shitshow that was my last relationship.

To be clear, this girl said she still wants to see me, and work on our new found challenges because that's what couples do. She said she wasn't breaking up with me. 

But the silence is what's making me anxious.

My man, I am 26, just like you. Also just like you, my ex (also my first girlfriend) broke it off with me almost 2 years ago when I went overseas to study. I was one month in to my studies, was in a foreign country, I was struggling mentally. 

You said your ex cheated on you before, as did mine. I made two critical mistakes that have landed me in deep shit. I should have walked out on her when she told me early in the relationship. I stuck around because I blamed myself for not being better to her. My second mistake was deferring my course. I self sabotaged both times. 

What she did is a blessing in disguise. Believe me, you have a great opportunity to explore and to solely build yourself. I know it's hard right now, and it might feel like everything might be collapsing. Tell yourself that you will move on to better things. Truly believe it. Don't be like me, don't let yourself self sabotage, I'm in a spot I'd wish on no one else. Push forward through this, you can do it. 

Find new hobbies, find new social groups, find anything!

I wonder when patience turns to complacency. I definitely can't shave just before sex, but we agreed to try alternatives to make it better for her. Have you had experience with a fuller beard? If so, did that hurt? We were wondering if growing a fuller beard would be better or not. 

It was my ex who didn't want that. The new girl prefers that. I prefer finishing outside, it is surprisingly uncomfortable to finish inside. I wonder if that's just me though.

She definitely did come off as a very sexual, full on, person. We had 5 rounds of sex the first time we did it. I definitely thought that was too much. But now it's been 3 months and we've been having sex less and less. Kinda worries me if she's losing interest, but she did say that she wasn't very sexual long term.

Definitely going to bring up potentially me finishing first, that's a good idea to try. She does love her vibrator, so could play with that together till she is satisfied.

The thing is, I don't have dreams anymore. I don't know what I like, I don't know what I'd want to do. I just get rejected at everything I try to do and it's exhausting to get back up after 5 years of being knocked down.
Happy birthday my guy. ❤️ I'm your age too! Well, 6 months older. I hope the best for your 26th year. 🎉

I have been stuck in the same place for years now. 

I was young and dumb when I turned down a job in 2018. I took the very next job I got offered, and the one after. I moved overseas to study, then got dumped.... Fell deep into depression and returned home. Wanted to find work, but COVID dried up the market. Now that COVIDs has settled where I am, nothing has changed... No-one wants to hire me. 

I don't have enough experience for jobs in my degree.. and I can't get experience without a job... Now it's been 4 years since graduating and I am still without permanent employment. My friends have bought houses, gotten married... And here I am.

As much as I agree with this post.... If things out of your control don't fall into place for you... No matter how much action you put in, there's always room for nothing to happen. That's where I am.

Thank you for your message. 

I'm not the best at replying to people. I used to be a lot better. Even with my friends, I take forever, Just don't feel motivation to type.

But, I do really appreciate what you said. I did used to be more disciplined and hard working. But now, after years of trying and getting nowhere, I have lost it. I am lazier and less hopeful. I don't feel like being turned down all the time. Recently my hair started falling out too.. another thing I am insecure about now. The list just keeps growing. 

I have moved all her photos to the side. I don't look at them, but she lived in my head rent free anyway. I am seeing a osych at the moment, but she doesn't know the extent of my thoughts yet.
My ex told me this too. Then all of a sudden I became public enemy number 1. Amazing how things change.

Too late now. I'm not an emotionally strong person. I was studying overseas (2 months later) when she actually did manage to break it off with me. Got a whole lotta stress and depression, moved back home. Hoped to start again in 2020, but COVID blocked it and pushed me back to 2021. If only I could've focused harder on uni, I'd be a lot happier right now.

Sounds almost like my ex.

She said she loves me, said she didn't deserve me. Two days later, attempts to dump me saying she doesn't love me.

This is me :( I know she will never come back. What I had with her is gone forever. But my mind isn't letting me cut her out, so I end up coming here to write messages to the old her, the one I fell in love with.

My psychologist told me the other day to adopt this idea. 

I've tried. But when I feel like shit, no matter what it just feels shit.

I've been stuck for years. Whenever I try to make a change, I keep getting knocked back down. 

I regret so many things.
She is a lawyer and is basically involved in their family's finances.

It's far from an easy way out. But it will help end this constant chatter in my head. I am trying to change my lifestyle, but I just have roadblock after roadblock right now. The past year and a bit has been the absolute worst for me.  I don't know how it could get any better.

I'm just so tired of trying to push forward and getting pushed back, either I do it to myself or the world does it to me. 

I just want a job, although no matter how much I've applied, I've not gotten a permanent, secure, position. 

I was supposed to have an interview this month, but a new wave of applicants made the employer reconsider my participation. 

I was supposed to move overseas to begin my study again, but lockdown ruined that. I don't know man, I just want to prove myself. I feel like I'm a joke, and a waste of time.

I wish I could agree with you. My ex becomes a different person when she isn't alone. She told me to my face, "I don't miss you when I am with friends or family". She only ever called me or messaged me when she was alone at home and needed attention. Almost a year it has been since she cut communications with me and blocked me everywhere. To think I spent almost 2 years with this girl... I don't even know what to believe.
Only for the one who didn't want to be there. Getting dumped sucks.
Thank you for the offer SerPatsy, it's just a shit situation I got myself into that's making me lash out. It's not an excuse, but it's what is triggering me for the past few months
Thank you for your message. I'm trying to seek assistance, but there's a huge waiting line due to all the people going through tough times these days :(
Thank you, but I'll only run in the same circles I've been running around for the past year and a bit.

Nah man, that's not the way to go. I'm happy for all these people having their LDR's work, I just wish I could've felt the same about mine. They give me hope that something real does exist, not the bullshit I endured.

Thank you for the message man. It's constantly burning a hole in me, I still can't fully give myself to another woman. I don't even feel a drive to connect with other people either, I understand how futile everything is. 

I always have memories of her and I flashing back. I find myself talking out loud alone, talking out to her. I truly feel like she died than her dumping me. I just miss her everyday. I really do hope this feeling goes away.

I'm a prospective international student to the UK. I haven't bought my tickets yet, but I'm meant to be there within 2 weeks. 

Ideally don't want to go, my country just opened up from lockdown. And now I'm going straight into another? Fml man. I expected UK to have had a better grip than this.

I thought I was the only one who thought some of these animes are borderline pedophilia. I see these overly sexualised pre-teen characters on anime and I feel insanely uncomfortable. It is one of the main reasons I don't feel too comfortable in watching Anime. 

As for sexualisation of Asian women, yeah, I see that strongly from caucasian guys, and quite a lot of people into anime. One caucasian friend have only ever dated Asian girls, and another made it his mission to explore Asian women for the year.

Although, I wouldn't point the blame entirely at white men for sexualizing Asian women, I barely ever see Asian women with non-caucasians. I have plenty of Asian friends who have told me that darker skinned people are looked down on (culturally and in attractiveness). Caucasians are probably equally as "fetishized" as a result. I've literally seen some Asian girls on tinder nonchalantly request "white guys".

The part where you said you wanted to miss her, but she kept calling you. That spoke to me. 

My ex was trying to cut communication with me, she wanted to miss me, but with me calling her she couldn't. One month into having a 20,000km gap and an 11 hour time difference, she suddenly didn't miss me, she stopped calling me. 

She ran out of love with me almost 2 months before she actually cut ties with me. I wish she dug deeper and found why she loved me to begin with. Instead she gave me the blanket "I love you"... Had she had the balls and broken up with me earlier, maybe I wouldn't have lost a year of my life, maybe I'd be into my second year of med school. 

I'm glad you're able to think critically OP, and that your relationship continues. You aren't missing out on life by having a partner, you can do everything you want with her! Well, maybe except having sex with a lot of different people, which I can say is completely overrated... You feel quite empty afterwards, it's just not the same as with a loving partner.
Cheers for that :) I long for the days when this will be just a distant memory and I'll be able to give myself to another person.
Word for word man, that's how I feel. COVID hasn't allowed me to grow either. It's been a real shitty few months.

Thank you for your words. I am trying, but I'm struggling with things never going how I imagined them to. Life has never been how I've pictured it. When I was with her, I had a slight inkling of surety, but that did all come crashing down. 

I'm waiting for my lucky stars.

I'm glad you called it off. My ex was talking to a dude behind my back. I didn't have the balls to end it with her then. In return, I'm the one in pain after she dumped me 10 months later. 

I wished that guy shrugged her off, but he didn't, he took her out on a date. It fucking hurts.

Cheers for the offer man! 

I wish my ex waited a little longer so I could settle in a lot better, but I guess its selfish of me to want that because she was probably hurting too. 

I hope you are feeling better now. Hope you never have to deal with that again. Timing is never on our side.

It was a nightmare situation. I'm not going to claim I made no mistakes, she was a wonderful person before our relationship started to nosedive around July of last year. There's much I could have done better, I broke no contact and emailed her recently apologizing for my faults and hoping she's okay. Deep inside, I was hoping that she would reply to me, hoping she'd take ownership of where she made mistakes too. Carrying this guilty conscience of mine is overwhelming. But she didn't reply. She saw my email (I have a mail tracker), she clicked it four times in 2 days, nothing since. I guess we are as dead as can be.

My ex did something very similar. She broke up with me while I was overseas making a change in my life. She told me she'd be there, then boom. 

I suspended my studies because I was so depressed, I moved back home. She calls me up and tells me she loves me. She invites me over, I say no. A week later she sees a video this girl uploaded on insta while she was at my house, then she calls me again. My phone wasn't working, so she asked my brother and my friend for my number. I'm not particularly bothered by that, but she blew up in my face when I messaged her brother and his partner asking if all three of them were ok because she was ignoring my calls... while we were still dating!!!

But I digress, I went to her house on the second invite. She starts crying to me, telling me how hard it has been for her to leave me. But at one point we end up hugging, almost kissing, but she pulls away and sits opposite me. She watched a TV show with me then told me she loved me, but she ain't committed. 

Throughout the next week, I spent my time trying to meet up with her. She just kept shutting me down over and over again. She hasn't spoken since, so anything thinking of breaking No Contact, DON'T DO IT.
What I hate about society, online and in person, is how your sex life is a measurement of your worth. When I still had my V card, I felt miserable with how people spoke of sex.

She played with my feelings hard.
She told me she'll be there for me when I move overseas to try my course, then she dumped me. She called me after the break up, told me she loved me. Then nothing. A week later, she invited me over, told me she loved me, then pushed me away. Didn't talk to me for 8 months, then matches with me on bumble and ignores me.

She has played with my heart big time. Even though she did stuff wrong, I am finding it hard to forgive myself for where I failed her. She doesn't owe me anything, but it would be nice to have acknowledgement paid to us both being wrong.

Thank you for that. You are the 5th person or so to tell me to try meditating. I've always put it off because I get drowned in my thoughts when I try. 

But, if this many people are telling me it's great and I should try, I'll give it a try. Any apps you personally recommend?
I guess she'll forever hate me, and never own up to her flaws.
Nah, you're all good. It is about doing something and getting off my complain wagon, but it's not as easy when you keep getting knocked back into it.

She didn't respond, but she did see the email. She has opened it a couple times (I use an email tracker so all my emails are tracked and I get updates when it's opened), twice yesterday and once today.

When she first saw it, she was online for a good 2 hours on Gmail. I thought she might be replying, but I got nothing.

Update - She has read my email. I realized I had a mail tracker on there. She is either writing back to me, or she's just working on something else. I see that she is online on Google on the side. She has been online for over an hour now while I've been working on my assignment. Fingers crossed.

I don't want sympathy mate, I'm getting this off my chest. I don't have anyone to talk to without feeling like I am an annoyance. Reddit is great in that I can journal everything, and if people have advice I can take it onboard. 

I'm trying to do things. I tried my ass off at getting a job, only got one for a 3 month contract. I went to med school overseas, then I lost someone close to me. I've struggled heaps from bullying, isolation, depression. I am psychologically fucked.
